dominant_cost_classification.frequency: inherent (one refresh per semantic event, 48/token); not the root cause
dominant_cost_classification.language_runtime_integration: not dominant (C++ /O2 /arch:AVX2); the 3.65x runtime inflation is memory/LLC contention with inference threads

exact_incremental_reformulation.expected_offline_cost: low single-digit microseconds per event (ESTIMATE, to be measured in rung R5); with the 4x pre-registered transfer: <= ~0.6 ms/token
exact_incremental_reformulation.identity: reference score_i[e] = sum_{c in cur} v(c,e) * g^(i - last(c,e)) = g^i * sum_c w(c,e) with w = v * g^(-last). g^i is common to all e, so ranking by sum_c w(c,e) is identical to the reference ranking (up to floating-point summation order).
exact_incremental_reformulation.risk: floating-point ties may order differently from the reference -> event-level set agreement is a secondary endpoint and a conformance-gate requirement
exact_incremental_reformulation.storage: dense 128 x 128 per layer (float64: 128 KiB/layer, 6 MiB total), renormalise a layer by g^(i0) when g^(-i) exceeds 1e200
exact_incremental_reformulation.update: w(c,e) += g^(-i) for the 64 changed cells; ONE pow per event, not per cell

measured_totals.per_probe_ns_offline: 123,679 ns / ~1,088 probes (1024 predict + 64 update) = ~114 ns per probe -> consistent with a cache-missing hash probe + pow, not with arithmetic

why_micro_optimisation_is_insufficient: Even an exact ~100x cheaper predictor leaves the CURRENT mechanism at net ~+0.42 ms/token (its value ceiling is 0.57 ms): break-even, not a resolvable or useful win. Cost engineering is necessary but cannot be sufficient; the value must come from a different decision.
